description: Level-3 ruleset for Indian loan agreements. Finance is regulation-driven: the dominant feature is WHO the lender is (bank / NBFC / private / foreign), which fans out into RBI, FEMA, SARFAESI, usury and TDS obligations. The current blueprint barely branches (2 conditionals) — this ruleset surfaces the gaps and a real bug.

feature_taxonomy.derive: lender_is_nbfc = lender_type==nbfc; lender_is_regulated = lender_type in {scheduled_bank, nbfc}; is_cross_border = lender_type==foreign
feature_taxonomy.note: The single biggest driver — fans out into multiple regulatory flags.
Secured vs unsecured changes the security + enforcement clauses fundamentally.

missing_features_gaps.why_needed: Foreign lender / funds from abroad triggers FEMA + ECB (External Commercial Borrowing) compliance.
Stamp duty (state-specific) and some RBI thresholds scale with amount.
missing_features_gaps.status: GAP — handled only by IRE stamp-duty validation, not as a clause/feature.

baseline_clauses.why: Interest rate — must not be usurious; TDS on interest applies.
baseline_clauses.legal_basis: Usurious Loans Act, 1918; IT Act s.194A (TDS on interest); RBI rate guidance

baseline_clauses.why: Repayment schedule (flat — see gap G6 for a variant).

rules.why: NBFC must follow RBI KYC/AML and data norms (dedicated clause).
rules.legal_basis: PMLA 2002; RBI KYC Directions; DPDP Act 2023
rules.wired: 2026-06-08 (was gap G5 — replaced generic data-processing reuse)

rules.why: Security / collateral — included ONLY for secured loans. is_secured is derived from collateral being present.
rules.legal_basis: Transfer of Property Act, 1882; SARFAESI (regulated lenders only)

rules.why: Foreign lender / overseas funds → FEMA + ECB compliance.
SARFAESI enforcement rights for scheduled banks / NBFCs only (clause self-limits to eligible lenders).

proposed_rules_gaps.status: RESOLVED 2026-06-08 — security moved from required to conditional rule LOAN-R3 (include_if is_secured == true). is_secured derived in generationControls. Unsecured loans no longer get a security clause.
RESOLVED 2026-06-08 — wired as rule LOAN-R5 (lender_is_regulated; clause self-limits to eligible lenders).

proposed_rules_gaps.why: TDS on interest (s.194A) should be an explicit clause, not buried.
proposed_rules_gaps.status: OPEN — may be partly covered inside LOAN_INTEREST_001; verify before authoring.
RESOLVED 2026-06-08 — rule LOAN-R1 now uses the dedicated KYC/AML clause instead of generic data-processing.

proposed_rules_gaps.why: Repayment should vary (bullet vs EMI vs milestone) like the Service payment variant.
proposed_rules_gaps.status: OPEN — variant opportunity, clauses not built (lower priority than compliance).

fallback_policy.principle: Open-world honest degradation, with a regulatory floor: usury, TDS and (for regulated lenders) RBI norms always apply. If lender type or cross-border status is unknown, assume the SAFER stance (e.g. do not assert SARFAESI rights) and flag.
fallback_policy.review_message: Lending is heavily regulated (RBI/FEMA/SARFAESI). This draft may not reflect lender-type-specific obligations — a lawyer review is strongly recommended.

gaps_summary: BUG (G1): security clause is forced even on unsecured loans. This is the headline finding — and it exposes a real ENGINE limitation: the format supports add/replace but NOT 'conditionally remove a required clause'. Either add a 'remove'/'mandatory:false' action, or model security as a variant slot (secured vs unsecured).

REGULATORY GAPS: no FEMA/ECB (G2), no SARFAESI-gated enforcement (G3, also a correctness risk), KYC/AML reuses the wrong clause (G5). Finance needs a 'regulatory-trigger' feature class driven by lender_type.

FORMAT VALIDATION (3rd type): the ruleset format held, but loan revealed TWO new needs the first two types didn't — (a) conditional REMOVAL of a baseline clause (unsecured), and (b) one feature (lender_type) deriving MANY regulatory flags. Both should inform the eventual ruleset→blueprint generator. This is exactly why we validated on 3 types before building it.
execution_note: Maps onto knowledge-base/clause_library/blueprints/loan.blueprint.json. `rules` reflect the live blueprint (2 conditionals). `proposed_rules_gaps` are NOT wired and mostly reference clauses that don't exist yet. G1 cannot be fixed by adding a clause — it needs an engine change (conditional removal) or a variant slot; do not silently leave unsecured loans with a security clause.
